title: CI clippy gate fails: cargo clippy -D warnings exits 101
description:
`.github/workflows/ci.yml:34` runs `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`. Running that exact command on main exits 101, so the CI check job fails on every push and PR.

Ten warnings, three in hand-written code:
- persona-attestors/src/fido2.rs:64 — `redundant_closure`: `spawn_blocking(|| ctap_hid_fido2::get_fidokey_devices())` should pass the function itself. Only fires with `--all-features`.
- persona-attestors/src/gpg.rs:66 — `collapsible_if`: the `if current_uid.is_none()` inside the `Some(&"uid")` match arm collapses into the arm guard.
- persona-grpc/src/service.rs:125 — `unnecessary_map_or`: suggests `is_none_or`. Do NOT apply this one: `Option::is_none_or` stabilised in Rust 1.82 and the declared MSRV is 1.75. Clippy only suggests it because no crate inherits `rust-version` (see the MSRV issue).

Seven more are `result_large_err` from the tonic-generated code included at persona-grpc/src/lib.rs:9. Suppress those at the include site (`#![allow(clippy::result_large_err)]` inside `pub mod workload`) rather than weakening the workspace lint level.

Left as-is, the gate is permanently red and stops signalling anything.
